seo.title: Security | diBoaS
seo.description: How diBoaS protects your money. Your wallet, your keys. Non-custodial architecture. 24/7 monitoring.
seo.ogDescription: Your wallet, your keys. How diBoaS protects your money with non-custodial architecture and 24/7 monitoring.

wallet.title: Your Wallet, Your Keys
paragraphs: Every user gets their own wallet with their own private key.
diBoaS never sees, holds, or has access to your key. If you ever need to recover access, recovery runs through an independent partner, never through diBoaS.
If diBoaS disappeared tomorrow, your money would still be yours.

protection.title: How We Protect Your Funds
paragraphs: Not even diBoaS can access your funds.
Transaction signing always requires your approval.

technology.title: The Technology
paragraphs: Built on open-source and decentralized financial infrastructure.
Every transaction is verifiable, every system is auditable.
We only use audited, established protocols. Each one is listed on our protocols page with its track record.
Every strategy is built on protocols with a public on-chain history, and positions are monitored 24/7.

whatWeDontDo.title: What We Don't Do
paragraphs: We never hold your private keys.
We never make transactions without your approval.
We never store your funds on our servers.
We are not a bank and your funds are not insured.
